segmentation.tooltip.add_to_render_queue: Queue this segmentation for the selected project. A reference image and description are required.
segmentation.tooltip.choose_a_reference_: Select one PNG, JPEG, or WebP image from your computer. You must select it again after refreshing the page.
segmentation.tooltip.confidence_threshol: Set how confident SAM must be before including a match. Lower values may include more objects; higher values are more selective. Use a value from 0 to 1.
segmentation.tooltip.cropped_cutout_png_: Save a transparent cutout trimmed to the selected objects with a small margin, instead of the full image size. It can also feed a chained 3D render.
segmentation.tooltip.download_6964bb: Save the selected segmentation result to your computer.
segmentation.tooltip.estimated_render_ti: Shows an estimate when Forge has enough history from similar renders. Actual time can vary.
segmentation.tooltip.export_e86349: Choose the picture to save: a transparent cutout, a black-and-white mask, the original with the selection outlined, or a cutout trimmed to the selection.
segmentation.tooltip.mask_png_710280: Save a black-and-white mask: selected areas are white and everything else is black.
segmentation.tooltip.most_matches_to_kee: How many of the highest-scoring matches to keep, from 1 to 50. If SAM finds fewer, all of them are kept.
segmentation.tooltip.outline_overlay_png: Save the original image with a colored outline around each selected object. Nothing is made transparent; use it to check what SAM selected.
segmentation.tooltip.preview_fdda4c: Open this saved segmentation result in the preview.
segmentation.tooltip.recent_creations_80: Browse and download segmentation results saved in the selected project.
segmentation.tooltip.reference_image_4fa: Choose one PNG, JPEG, or WebP image up to 10 MiB and 20 megapixels. SAM finds the objects you describe in this image.
segmentation.tooltip.transparent_png_3d3: Save the original image with unselected areas made transparent. Selected objects keep their original colors.
segmentation.tooltip.what_would_you_like: Describe the object or objects to select in the reference image. Short, specific descriptions work best.
segmentation.tooltip.which_matches_8918d: SAM often finds several matches. Combine them all, keep only the one it is most sure about, keep only the biggest, or keep a chosen number of the best-scoring ones.
